headline: Approved rule changes on continuances and hearing times, consolidated three Caesar Bristol LLC cases, and tabled a representation rule.
summary: The meeting covered rules for hearings. Members approved changes to continuances and time limits, and tabled a rule on who may represent parties. They also consolidated three cases against Caesar Bristol LLC.
decisions: Approved amending Rule 12.2 so the chair may grant a continuance at his discretion, with any further continuances voted on by the commission.
Approved raising the time for items 4 and 5 under Rule 14 to three minutes.
Approved adding the words unless the commission allows more to the Rule 14 time limits.
Approved consolidating three cases against Caesar Bristol LLC into one hearing.
Approved that when cases are consolidated, the common party's time is combined and divided by the number of moving parties.
Approved the appointment of a vice chair.
Tabled the discussion of rules on non-attorney representation.
Tabled the vote to accept revised commission procedures.
discussion: Continuances: Members discussed letting the chair grant a first continuance without a vote, with later ones going to the commission, and keeping rent the same during any delay.
Cross-examination: Members debated whether tenant and landlord cross-examination adds value, citing concerns about adversarial exchanges and wasted time.
Non-attorney representation: Members discussed power of attorney forms, whether a non-lawyer may argue for a tenant, and whether a tenant may send a representative who cannot attend.
Shared time in consolidated cases: Members discussed how time should be divided when several tenants or several owners share one hearing.
Summary judgment: Members said a summary judgment process was discussed but not finished, and that it would need to be checked with staff.
